title: RD-MT164-DiagnosticsTierWiring

scope.summary:
GOAL: Make the HBR-INT-009 three-tier diagnostic posture EXPLICIT AND MACHINE-CHECKED for every new WP-017 behavior family, instead of leaving tier wiring implicit per-MT. This MT produces a single machine-readable WIRING MANIFEST that enumerates each WP-017 behavior family x each of the three diagnostic tiers (Flight Recorder, internal_diagnostics, Palmistry) and records, for each cell, a typed posture: WIRED (a real producer exists here), DEFERRED-with-reason (the tier's producer tool is not shipped in this worktree yet), or NOT_APPLICABLE-with-reason. A conformance test asserts the manifest is total (no behavior family, no tier, silently missing) and that every non-WIRED cell carries a reason + follow-up ref. This is the anti-silent-skip control the whole RD group leans on: MT-161/162/163 each declare 'internal_diagnostics/palmistry: typed DEFERRED unless the tier exists at implementation time; disposition recorded by MT-164' — THIS MT is where that disposition is centrally recorded and enforced.

THREE-TIER MODEL (master-spec diagnostic model, do not blur): Tier-1 Flight Recorder = business-event ledger, KEPT AS-IS, additive event kinds only (built by MT-161); it is WIRED HERE for every WP-017 behavior because MT-161 defined the emission catalogue. Tier-2 internal_diagnostics = in-app self-diagnostics (panic/heartbeat/frame/resource/open-event producer) built by WP-KERNEL-015 (retrofit 016). Tier-3 Palmistry = external out-of-process watcher, also WP-KERNEL-015/016. Tiers 2 and 3 MAY NOT EXIST when WP-017 runs; wiring to them must be typed DEFERRED(reason=WP-KERNEL-015-not-shipped) per HBR-INT-009 -- NEVER silently skipped, NEVER faked as WIRED. If, at implementation time, the internal_diagnostics/Palmistry producer symbols ARE present in the crate, the implementing session flips the affected cells from DEFERRED to WIRED and adds the compile-anchor + test; the manifest is the single place that decision is recorded with an operator-visible diff.

EXPECTED DIFF SHAPE: (a) new file src/backend/handshake_core/src/flight_recorder/agent_steering_tier_wiring.rs containing AgentSteeringTierWiringRow + the manifest function agent_steering_tier_wiring_manifest() -> Vec<AgentSteeringTierWiringRow> + verify_agent_steering_tier_wiring(...) -> Result<(), Vec<TierWiringError>>; (b) one-line pub mod + re-export in src/backend/handshake_core/src/flight_recorder/mod.rs; (c) new test file src/backend/handshake_core/tests/agent_steering_tier_wiring_tests.rs. NO product call sites, NO tier producers built here (that is WP-KERNEL-015); this MT only records and enforces the posture. Reuse crate::user_manual::behavior_coverage::DiagnosticTierPosture (the compiled Wired/DeferredWithReason/NotApplicableWithReason enum, behavior_coverage.rs lines 32-47) rather than defining a parallel posture enum -- the whole point is ONE posture vocabulary across the product.

DETAILED SPEC -- BEHAVIOR FAMILIES (rows; behavior_family_id in stable dotted form wp17.<family>; each family lists its Tier-1 FR event ids from the MT-161 catalogue so the manifest and the emission catalogue can never drift):
  1. wp17.session_lifecycle          -- session launch/resume lifecycle. FR ids: FR-EVT-SESSION-RESUMED (+ the session-family launch events). 
  2. wp17.steer_ack                  -- steer queue/deliver/ack/reject. FR ids: FR-EVT-SESSION-STEER-{QUEUED,DELIVERED,ACKED,REJECTED}.
  3. wp17.interrupt                  -- interrupt request/confirm. FR ids: FR-EVT-SESSION-INTERRUPT-{REQUESTED,CONFIRMED}.
  4. wp17.resume                     -- thread resume after interrupt/restart. FR ids: FR-EVT-SESSION-RESUMED.
  5. wp17.m2m_spawn                  -- model-to-model spawn request/deny. FR ids: FR-EVT-M2M-SPAWN-{REQUESTED,DENIED}.
  6. wp17.m2m_steer                  -- model-to-model steer/notify. FR ids: FR-EVT-M2M-{STEER,NOTIFY}.
  7. wp17.role_injection             -- role protocol/persona injection. FR ids: FR-EVT-ROLE-{INJECTED,INJECTION-REJECTED}.
  8. wp17.mt_signals                 -- MT dispatch loop signals. FR ids: FR-EVT-MT-{DISPATCHED,SIGNALED,HANDOFF}.
  9. wp17.merge_ops                  -- worktree merge-back lifecycle. FR ids: FR-EVT-MERGE-{PROPOSED,APPROVED,EXECUTED,CONFLICTED,ABORTED}.
  10. wp17.annotation_ops            -- annotation create/reanchor/orphan/delete. FR ids: FR-EVT-ANNOTATION-{CREATED,REANCHORED,ORPHANED,DELETED}.
The family list MUST cover every FR event id defined by MT-161 (the test asserts set-coverage against AgentSteeringFrEventId::all() so a new MT-161 id with no manifest home fails the build). If the session/role/annotation families add additive FR ids later, this manifest gains the row additively in the same UPPER wp17.<family> namespace.

ROW SHAPE (AgentSteeringTierWiringRow):
  behavior_family_id: &'static str (wp17.*),
  fr_event_ids: &'static [&'static str] (the exact MT-161 id strings this family emits),
  flight_recorder_posture: DiagnosticTierPosture (ALWAYS Wired for WP-017 families -- MT-161 built the tier),
  flight_recorder_surface: &'static str (the MT-161 helper module path -- 'flight_recorder::events_agent_steering'),
  internal_diagnostics_posture: DiagnosticTierPosture,
  palmistry_posture: DiagnosticTierPosture,
  deferred_reason: Option<&'static str> (REQUIRED when either tier-2/tier-3 posture is DeferredWithReason or NotApplicableWithReason),
  follow_up_ref: Option<&'static str> (REQUIRED for DeferredWithReason -- e.g. 'palmistry://wp17/<family>' or 'WP-KERNEL-015'),
  transcript_wired: bool (whether MT-163 maps this family into the session transcript -- true for session/steer/interrupt/resume/m2m/mt_signals; false for merge/annotation which have no transcript surface),
  ledger_wired: bool (whether MT-162 persists this family in the SurrealDB ledgers -- true for steer/m2m/mt/merge; false for pure-annotation until the annotation family ships its ledger).

VERIFY CONTRACT (verify_agent_steering_tier_wiring, modeled on user_manual::behavior_coverage::verify_* at behavior_coverage.rs lines 438-583 and 867-1121): (a) every row's flight_recorder_posture == Wired (WP-017 Tier-1 is built); (b) any row whose internal_diagnostics_posture or palmistry_posture is DeferredWithReason MUST have deferred_reason.is_some() AND follow_up_ref.is_some() -- exactly the rule enforced at behavior_coverage.rs lines 555-564; (c) any NotApplicableWithReason posture MUST have deferred_reason.is_some() (behavior_coverage.rs lines 565-573); (d) fr_event_ids for every row are non-empty and each string round-trips through AgentSteeringFrEventId::from_str_id (no typo'd id, no orphan id); (e) the UNION of all rows' fr_event_ids equals AgentSteeringFrEventId::all() as strings (totality: no MT-161 id without a manifest home, no manifest id that MT-161 does not define); (f) behavior_family_id values are unique. Errors are returned as a typed Vec, never panics, so the manifest can be surfaced as a diff at closeout.

STEP-BY-STEP IMPLEMENTATION:
1. Read the grounding first: crate::user_manual::behavior_coverage.rs (DiagnosticTierPosture enum lines 32-47, BehaviorCoverageRow lines 49-62 with internal_diagnostics_posture/palmistry_posture/deferred_reason/follow_up_ref, the DEFERRED/NOT_APPLICABLE reason-required checks lines 545-573, and the declared HBR-INT-009 marker discipline lines 1101-1114 -- this is the authoritative posture pattern to reuse, NOT reinvent); flight_recorder/events_agent_steering.rs (MT-161: AgentSteeringFrEventId::all/as_str/from_str_id -- the id source of truth); the MT-161/162/163 contracts' hbr_int_009_tier_obligations blocks (the DEFERRED language this MT centralizes).
2. Create agent_steering_tier_wiring.rs: define AgentSteeringTierWiringRow, TierWiringError (Display + Error, mirroring BehaviorCoverageError lines 415-436), the const manifest of 10 rows above, agent_steering_tier_wiring_manifest(), and verify_agent_steering_tier_wiring(rows, fr_ids) applying checks (a)-(f).
3. Set every WP-017 row's tier-2/tier-3 posture to DiagnosticTierPosture::DeferredWithReason with deferred_reason = 'internal_diagnostics and Palmistry producers are built by WP-KERNEL-015 (retrofit 016) and are not shipping in this worktree' and follow_up_ref = 'WP-KERNEL-015' (or a palmistry:// ref) -- UNLESS the WP-KERNEL-015 producer symbols are present in the crate at implementation time, in which case flip the affected cells to Wired and add a compile-anchor (let _ = <symbol>;) proving the producer exists, exactly like behavior_coverage.rs assert_compiled (lines 163-263).
4. Register the module in flight_recorder/mod.rs (pub mod + re-export of the row type, manifest fn, verify fn).
5. Author tests/agent_steering_tier_wiring_tests.rs: (a) verify_agent_steering_tier_wiring(manifest, AgentSteeringFrEventId::all-as-strings) returns Ok; (b) totality: union of fr_event_ids equals AgentSteeringFrEventId::all() (add a deliberately-omitted-id negative test asserting the verify FAILS when a family is dropped); (c) every DEFERRED cell has reason+follow_up (mutate one to drop the reason -> expect Err); (d) flight_recorder_posture is Wired for all rows; (e) behavior_family_id uniqueness; (f) a snapshot/dump test that serializes the manifest to serde_json::Value so the closeout can diff the posture table.
6. cargo build -p handshake_core green; clippy clean.
forbidden_paths: app/src/** (no React surface; this MT is a headless manifest + conformance check)
.GOV/** (posture disposition is recorded in product code + surfaced at governance closeout; product code never writes .GOV)
src/backend/handshake_core/src/flight_recorder/events_agent_steering.rs (MT-161 owns the FR catalogue; consume AgentSteeringFrEventId, do not edit)
src/backend/handshake_core/src/user_manual/behavior_coverage.rs (reuse DiagnosticTierPosture; do NOT modify the existing coverage matrices)
src/backend/handshake_core/src/diagnostics/** (WP-KERNEL-015 internal_diagnostics tier; NOT built here -- referenced as DEFERRED only)
src/backend/handshake_core/src/swarm_orchestration/** (ledger is MT-162; no call sites here)
acceptance_criteria: agent_steering_tier_wiring.rs exists, is registered in flight_recorder/mod.rs, and cargo build -p handshake_core is green.

The manifest enumerates every WP-017 behavior family (>=10 rows: session_lifecycle, steer_ack, interrupt, resume, m2m_spawn, m2m_steer, role_injection, mt_signals, merge_ops, annotation_ops) with all three tier postures explicit -- no family and no tier omitted.
Reuses crate::user_manual::behavior_coverage::DiagnosticTierPosture (single posture vocabulary); no parallel posture enum is introduced.
Every WP-017 row's flight_recorder_posture is Wired (Tier-1 built by MT-161); proven by test.

Every internal_diagnostics/palmistry cell is either Wired (with a compile-anchored producer symbol) or DeferredWithReason/NotApplicableWithReason with a non-empty deferred_reason AND (for DEFERRED) a follow_up_ref -- NO silent skip; proven by test and by a negative test that drops a reason and expects Err.
Totality: the union of all rows' fr_event_ids equals AgentSteeringFrEventId::all() as strings -- a new MT-161 id with no manifest home fails verify (negative test proves it).
Every fr_event_ids entry round-trips through AgentSteeringFrEventId::from_str_id (no typo, no orphan id).
behavior_family_id values are unique; verify returns a typed Vec of errors and never panics.
A serde_json dump of the manifest is available so the WP closeout can surface the posture table as an operator-visible diff.
clippy clean; no tier producers built here (WP-KERNEL-015 boundary respected).
proof_targets: cargo test -p handshake_core agent_steering_tier_wiring --nocapture 2>&1 | tee /tmp/mt164_run.txt && grep -E 'test result: ok' /tmp/mt164_run.txt
grep -c 'wp17\.' src/backend/handshake_core/src/flight_recorder/agent_steering_tier_wiring.rs | awk '{ if ($1 >= 10) print "FAMILIES_OK" }' | grep -q FAMILIES_OK
expected_tests: verify_agent_steering_tier_wiring(manifest) returns Ok on the shipped manifest
totality: union(fr_event_ids) == AgentSteeringFrEventId::all() (+ negative: dropped family -> Err)
DEFERRED-with-reason requires deferred_reason + follow_up_ref (+ negative: dropped reason -> Err)
flight_recorder_posture == Wired for every WP-017 row
serde_json manifest dump shape (closeout diff input)
implementation_notes: HBR-INT-009 is the whole point: the manifest is the single, testable place the three-tier posture is asserted. The MT-161/162/163 contracts each say 'disposition recorded by MT-164' -- this MT closes that loop. Do not scatter tier bookkeeping back into those MTs.

Reuse, do not fork: DiagnosticTierPosture and the DEFERRED/NOT_APPLICABLE reason-required rule already exist in user_manual::behavior_coverage (lines 545-573). Import them; a second posture enum would create exactly the drift this MT exists to prevent.

The Wired-vs-Deferred flip is a real implementation-time decision, not a rubber stamp: if the WP-KERNEL-015 internal_diagnostics/Palmistry producer symbols compile in this worktree, flip the cell to Wired and add a compile-anchor (let _ = <producer_symbol>;) so the manifest cannot claim WIRED for a producer that does not exist -- mirror behavior_coverage.rs assert_compiled (lines 163-263).

Totality against AgentSteeringFrEventId::all() is the anti-drift seam: if MT-161 or a later WP-017 family adds an FR id, the build fails until this manifest gives it a tier home -- that is intended pressure, not a bug.

This MT has no runtime call sites and no operator surface; its acceptance surface is the conformance test + the closeout posture diff. It is support-grade governance that unblocks honest RD-family closeout, not a shippable feature.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless conformance-manifest MT; no operator-visible surface. The posture table becomes operator-visible as a governance-closeout diff and (optionally) via the MT-166 audit surface's tier-posture column; the machine-readable manifest dump satisfies trace-projection reconstructability.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: No operator-usable behavior ships here; the three-tier posture is documented for operators/models in the MT-165 manual entries (agent-harness observability + HBR-INT-009 posture section), which cite this manifest as the machine-readable source of the DEFERRED dispositions.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations: flight_recorder: WIRED for every WP-017 family (MT-161 built the emission catalogue) -- this manifest asserts flight_recorder_posture == Wired for all rows

internal_diagnostics: typed DEFERRED(reason=WP-KERNEL-015-not-shipped) with follow_up_ref recorded PER FAMILY in this manifest, unless the WP-KERNEL-015 producer symbols compile at implementation time (then flipped to WIRED with a compile-anchor)

palmistry: typed DEFERRED(reason=WP-KERNEL-015-not-shipped) with follow_up_ref recorded PER FAMILY in this manifest, unless Palmistry exists at implementation time (then flipped to WIRED with a compile-anchor) -- THIS MT is the central place both DEFERRED dispositions live and are enforced
risk_if_missed: The three-tier posture stays implicit and per-MT: some family silently skips tier-2/tier-3 wiring with no reason and no follow-up, HBR-INT-009 becomes unverifiable, and when WP-KERNEL-015 ships nobody has a checklist of which WP-017 behaviors still need internal_diagnostics/Palmistry producers -- the DEFERRED debt is lost.

risks: RISK-1: Silent skip -- a behavior family is simply omitted from the manifest, so its missing tier-2/tier-3 wiring is invisible and HBR-INT-009 is quietly violated.
RISK-2: Fake WIRED -- a cell is marked Wired for internal_diagnostics/Palmistry although no producer symbol exists in the worktree, turning the manifest into a lie the closeout trusts.
RISK-3: Posture-vocabulary drift -- a parallel posture enum is defined here instead of reusing DiagnosticTierPosture, so the product ends up with two incompatible three-tier vocabularies.
RISK-4: FR-id drift -- the manifest lists fr_event_ids by hand and they fall out of sync with the MT-161 catalogue (typo, renamed id, or a new id with no manifest home).
RISK-5: Reason theatre -- DEFERRED cells carry an empty or boilerplate reason with no follow_up_ref, satisfying the letter but not the intent of the typed-deferral rule.
minimum_controls: CTRL-1 (RISK-1): totality test asserts the union of every row's fr_event_ids equals AgentSteeringFrEventId::all(); a dropped family fails verify -- a family cannot be omitted without breaking the build.

CTRL-2 (RISK-2): a Wired internal_diagnostics/Palmistry cell REQUIRES a compile-anchor (let _ = <producer_symbol>;) proving the producer exists, mirroring behavior_coverage.rs assert_compiled; without a real symbol the only legal posture is DeferredWithReason.
CTRL-3 (RISK-3): the row type reuses crate::user_manual::behavior_coverage::DiagnosticTierPosture; a source grep in proof targets confirms the imported enum, and no new posture enum is defined.
CTRL-4 (RISK-4): every fr_event_ids string is round-tripped through AgentSteeringFrEventId::from_str_id in verify; the union==all() totality check catches both orphan and missing ids.

CTRL-5 (RISK-5): verify enforces deferred_reason.is_some() AND follow_up_ref.is_some() for DeferredWithReason (reason-required rule from behavior_coverage.rs 555-564); a negative test drops a reason and asserts Err.

research_provenance.source: Grounded in wtc-multi-model-orchestration-v1: user_manual/behavior_coverage.rs (DiagnosticTierPosture Wired/NotApplicableWithReason/DeferredWithReason lines 32-47, BehaviorCoverageRow tier fields lines 49-62, DEFERRED/NOT_APPLICABLE reason-required checks lines 545-573, assert_compiled compile-anchor pattern lines 163-263, BehaviorCoverageError Display/Error lines 415-436, verify_* HBR-INT-009 marker discipline lines 1087-1114), flight_recorder/events_agent_steering.rs (MT-161 AgentSteeringFrEventId::all/as_str/from_str_id -- id source of truth), MT-161/162/163 contracts (each hbr_int_009_tier_obligations block delegates the DEFERRED disposition to MT-164). Master-spec three-tier diagnostic model: Flight Recorder (Tier-1, KEPT AS-IS) / internal_diagnostics (Tier-2, WP-KERNEL-015) / Palmistry (Tier-3, WP-KERNEL-015/016).
corrections: Confirmed the product already ships a compiled three-tier posture vocabulary (DiagnosticTierPosture) and a reason-required enforcement for DEFERRED/NOT_APPLICABLE cells (behavior_coverage.rs 545-573) -- the contract reuses it rather than defining a new enum, eliminating the drift risk a parallel vocabulary would create.

Verified the DEFERRED reason string used across the codebase names WP-KERNEL-012/016 for the ModelRuntime coverage (behavior_coverage.rs line 624); WP-017's tier-2/tier-3 producers are owned by WP-KERNEL-015 (retrofit 016) per the RD-group grounding, so the manifest's follow_up_ref points at WP-KERNEL-015.

Established totality against AgentSteeringFrEventId::all() as the anti-silent-skip seam so that any additive MT-161 id forces a manifest home -- this is the concrete mechanism behind 'never silently skipped' in HBR-INT-009.

surrealdb_authority_v02_205.supersedes: Any PostgreSQL, Postgres, PgPool, sqlx-postgres, SQL-DDL, JSONB, RLS, LISTEN-NOTIFY, pgvector, DATABASE_URL, PostgreSQL test-container, or PostgreSQL proof instruction elsewhere in this pre-pivot contract.
surrealdb_authority_v02_205.implementation_rule: When this MT reads or writes durable product state it MUST use the typed SurrealDB boundary created by MT-331..MT-334 and the authenticated record-user plus ResourceBroker privacy contract from MT-333. It MUST NOT add a PostgreSQL fallback, parallel authority, direct pool escape, or runtime dependency.
surrealdb_authority_v02_205.proof_rule: PostgreSQL-era fixtures and historical receipts do not prove this MT. Fresh real-SurrealDB proof is required for every storage-affected acceptance criterion; administrative SurrealDB credentials cannot prove privacy.
surrealdb_authority_v02_205.postgresql_data_migration: NOT_REQUIRED: the current PostgreSQL database contains no valuable live information. No MT may connect to it, import from it, fall back to it, or use it as proof.

surrealdb_translation_v02_205.schema_rule: Any embedded PostgreSQL DDL/SQL snippet is a semantic field/index/invariant inventory only. Implement it as SCHEMAFULL SurrealQL through SurrealKit; do not execute or mechanically transliterate the snippet.
surrealdb_translation_v02_205.concurrency_rule: Translate advisory locks, SKIP LOCKED and row locks into SurrealDB transactions, durable lease/fencing records and conditional updates with equivalent tests.
surrealdb_translation_v02_205.notification_rule: Translate LISTEN/NOTIFY into scoped SurrealDB live queries plus bounded resynchronization.
surrealdb_translation_v02_205.privacy_rule: Translate RLS into authenticated record-user table/field PERMISSIONS intersected with ResourceBroker; administrative credentials cannot prove privacy.
surrealdb_translation_v02_205.proof_rule: All named storage proofs run against real SurrealDB. No PostgreSQL process, driver, connection, fixture, environment variable or fallback is permitted.
